summary: The article provides a largely accurate and comprehensive guide to paying LIC premiums online, with most claims verified by official sources.

claims.claim: LIC has waived convenience fees on credit card payments to promote digital transactions.
claims.note: LIC's official website and other sources confirm that convenience fees for credit card payments are absorbed by LIC.

claims.claim: The grace period for monthly mode is 15 days; for quarterly, half-yearly, or yearly modes, it's one month but not less than 30 days.
claims.note: LIC's official policy guidelines confirm these grace periods.

claims.claim: If a double payment occurs, LIC typically refunds it within 6-8 days.
claims.note: LIC's official portal and other sources state that double payments are refunded within 6-8 days.

claims.claim: Online payment is generally available for 'in-force' ordinary policies and those eligible for spot revival. It is typically not available for policies under the Salary Savings Scheme (SSS), ULIP, Health, or e-term plans.
claims.note: LIC's official website and other sources confirm these eligibility criteria and exclusions.

claims.claim: E-receipts are generated instantly upon successful payment and are valid for income tax purposes, eliminating the need for physical receipts.
claims.note: LIC's official portal and other financial sites confirm that e-receipts are instantly generated and valid for income tax purposes.

claims.claim: Policyholders can deposit premiums up to the end of the current financial year. Additionally, premiums due in the next financial year can be paid up to three months in advance of their due date.
claims.note: LIC's official website confirms these rules for advance premium payments.

claims.claim: LIC also offers a dedicated mobile application, "LIC Digital," available on both Google Play Store and Apple App Store.
claims.note: LIC's official website and app store listings confirm the availability of the 'LIC Digital' app.

article_title: Paying LIC Premiums Online: A Step-by-Step Guide
